Body.Content:
Create and manage contextual discussion threads directly on planning cubes and dimensions. Users can comment on dimension cells, detailed or aggregate cube cells, and reporting rows; reply to and mention colleagues; receive email notifications; and resolve or reactivate discussions. Public and private visibility options, together with an All Comments view, filters, export, and role-based management actions, support collaboration throughout the planning cycle.

GA date: October CY2026
